speaker: walker
zh: 破曉低語
en: A dawn whisper

speaker: shade
zh: 我記得那塊石。你轉身離去時，我仍未停止呼喚。
en: I remember the stone. You walked away before I stopped calling.

speaker: shade
zh: 每位朝聖者都留下一道形影。尖塔已學會披上我們的模樣。
en: Each climber leaves a shape behind. The Spire has learned to wear ours.

speaker: shade
zh: 永恆君王之上沒有破曉——只有一扇偽裝成天空的門。
en: Above the Sovereign there is no dawn — only a door pretending to be the sky.

speaker: shade
zh: 我們從來不是為了逃出去而朝聖；我們一直把光送往鎖孔。
en: We were never climbing out. We were carrying light to the lock.

speaker: usurper
zh: 面具已碎。往上看。
en: The mask is broken. Look above.

speaker: omen
zh: 第八凶兆從來不是凶兆。它是一扇門投下的影。
en: THE EIGHTH OMEN WAS NEVER AN OMEN. IT WAS THE SHADOW OF A DOOR.

speaker: keeper
zh: 你醒了。火仍在。
en: You're awake. The fire is still here.

speaker: keeper
zh: 坐近一點。路可以等。
en: Sit closer. The road can wait.

speaker: keeper
zh: 爐火整夜沒有熄。
en: The fire didn't go out all night.

speaker: keeper
zh: 慢慢來。夜還長。
en: No hurry. The night is long.

speaker: keeper
zh: 手先暖了,再拿東西。
en: Warm your hands first. The rest can wait.

speaker: keeper
zh: 這把火,由第一夜燒到現在。
en: This fire has burned since the first night.

speaker: keeper
zh: 灰我清過了,柴也添過了。
en: I've cleared the ash and fed the fire.

speaker: keeper
zh: 外面有霜。多帶一層。
en: There's frost out. Take another layer.

speaker: keeper
zh: 路上冷,這裏不冷。
en: The road is cold. It is not cold here.

speaker: keeper
zh: 你的燈,我上了油。
en: I've oiled your lantern for you.

speaker: keeper
zh: 芯是新的,油是滿的。
en: New wick. Full oil.

speaker: keeper
zh: 願意走的時候,才走。
en: Leave when you want to. Not a moment sooner.

speaker: keeper
zh: 我在這裏。一直都在。
en: I'm here. I always am.

speaker: keeper
zh: 守夜的事,交給我。
en: Leave the vigil to me.

speaker: keeper
zh: 火光認得你。
en: The firelight knows you.

speaker: keeper
zh: 東西都在原位。這裏不變。
en: Everything is where it was. Nothing changes here.

speaker: keeper
zh: 窗我抹過了。亮的格,更亮。
en: I've wiped the panes. The lit ones shine better for it.

speaker: keeper
zh: 別站在門口,風大。
en: Don't stand in the doorway — the wind.

speaker: keeper
zh: 你睡着時,火暗了一次。我添了柴。
en: The fire sank while you slept. I fed it.

speaker: keeper
zh: 這條路,你行過的次數,比誰都多。
en: No one has walked that road more times than you.

speaker: keeper
zh: 第一段路,你會見到許多碑。不必停。
en: The first stretch has many monuments. You needn't stop for them.

speaker: keeper
zh: 這裏永遠有你的位。
en: There will always be a place for you here.

speaker: keeper
zh: 走得多遠,火都在原地。
en: However far you walk, the fire stays where it is.

speaker: keeper
zh: 選一件合手的。前人的手,與你的一樣。
en: Take whichever fits your hand. The hands before yours were just the same.

speaker: keeper
zh: 全是留下來的東西。留下來的,自有用處。
en: It's all left-behind things. What stays behind has its uses.

speaker: keeper
zh: 帶上它。它認得路。
en: Take it. It knows the road.

speaker: keeper
zh: 火留給我,你帶燈。
en: The fire stays with me. The lamp goes with you.

speaker: keeper
zh: 這道門,從不上鎖。
en: That door is never locked.

speaker: keeper
zh: 外面起風了。再坐一會。
en: The wind's up. Sit a while longer.

speaker: keeper
zh: 六格都亮起的那一天,門會開。
en: The day all six panes are lit, the door will open.

speaker: keeper
zh: 金城不會走掉。
en: The Gilded City isn't going anywhere.

speaker: keeper
zh: 有我看火,你便不必看。
en: I'll watch the fire, so you don't have to.

speaker: keeper
zh: 累了便睡。火自己會亮。
en: Sleep when you're tired. The fire minds itself.

speaker: keeper
zh: 今夜的火,燒得穩。
en: The fire burns steady tonight.

speaker: keeper
zh: 你望東面望得太久了。火在這一面。
en: You've been looking east too long. The fire is on this side.

speaker: keeper
zh: 慢火才燒得久。
en: A slow fire burns longest.

speaker: keeper
zh: 破曉之前,總是最冷。
en: It's coldest just before dawn.

speaker: keeper
zh: 燈也要歇。人更加要。
en: Even lamps rest. People need it more.

speaker: keeper
zh: 出去之前,再暖一暖手。
en: Before you go, warm your hands once more.

speaker: keeper
zh: 向東,一直向東。這一句不會錯。
en: East, and keep east. That much is always true.

speaker: keeper
zh: 灰會落,火會亮。一直如此。
en: Ash falls; fire burns. It has always been so.

speaker: keeper
zh: 我不送了。門口風大。
en: I won't see you out. The wind at the door is cruel.

speaker: keeper
zh: 窗中的東西,有一日你會看清。
en: One day you will see that window clearly.

speaker: keeper
zh: 今夜與上一夜,一樣長。
en: Tonight is as long as the last one.

speaker: keeper
zh: 多帶一枚金幣。路上伸手的多。
en: Take an extra coin. The road is full of open hands.

speaker: keeper
zh: 這一面暖。坐這一面。
en: This side is warmer. Sit on this side.

speaker: keeper
zh: 窗亮了一格。夜沒有之前那麼暗了。
en: One pane is lit. The nights are not so dark now.

speaker: keeper
zh: 那一格的光,顏色像爐火。
en: The light in that pane — the colour of this fire.

speaker: keeper
zh: 兩格了。窗開始記起自己的樣子。
en: Two now. The window is remembering its shape.

speaker: keeper
zh: 兩格亮了。餘下的,路知道在甚麼地方。
en: Two are lit. The road knows where the rest are waiting.

speaker: keeper
zh: 三格,半扇窗。半團火。
en: Three panes. Half a window. Half a fire.

speaker: keeper
zh: 窗亮到一半,我在夜裏都看得見它了。
en: Half-lit now. I can see it even in the dark hours.

speaker: keeper
zh: 四格。窗開始照出這裏的東西了。
en: Four. The window has begun to show the room.

speaker: keeper
zh: 還有兩片。之後的事,之後再說。
en: Two shards left. What comes after can wait for after.

speaker: keeper
zh: 五格,餘一片。慢慢來。
en: Five panes. One to go. There's no hurry.

speaker: keeper
zh: 五格了。窗比火還亮。
en: Five. The window outshines the fire now.

speaker: keeper
zh: 那盞燈冷。別放近火。
en: That lantern is cold. Keep it away from the fire.

speaker: keeper
zh: 今夜靜。連影都不吵了。
en: Quiet tonight. Even the shadows have stopped their noise.

speaker: keeper
zh: 路上那位提燈的老人家——他說的,信一半就好。
en: That old lamp-keeper on the road — believe half of what he says.

speaker: keeper
zh: 三片歸位。餘下三片,在更東的地方。
en: Three home. The other three lie further east.

speaker: walker
zh: 燈到石,石亮。原來石一直在等火。
en: The lamp reaches the stone, and the stone lights. It was waiting for fire all along.

speaker: walker
zh: 這段路,足跡比人多。
en: More footprints than people on this stretch.

speaker: walker
zh: 一步一步數。數到忘了為甚麼要數。
en: Counting steps, until I forget why I'm counting.

speaker: walker
zh: 石是誰放的?路沒有說。
en: Who set these stones? The road isn't saying.

speaker: walker
zh: 碑全部面向東。沒有一座面向爐火。
en: The monuments all face east. Not one faces the fire.

speaker: walker
zh: 油還有,便不去數餘下的石。
en: While there's oil, don't count the stones ahead.

speaker: walker
zh: 風把灰帶向西。灰認得那個方向。
en: The wind carries the ash west. The ash knows that way.

speaker: walker
zh: 石座有燒痕,一層下面另有一層。
en: Scorch marks at the stone's base — a layer, and under it another.

speaker: walker
zh: 越往東,路越靜。
en: The further east, the quieter the road.

speaker: walker
zh: 回頭,西面仍有火光。仍未算遠。
en: Looking back, the firelight is still there. Not far yet, then.

speaker: walker
zh: 引路石不引人回頭。
en: Waystones never point back.

speaker: walker
zh: 像有人與我同行。回頭,只有碑。
en: It feels like company on this road. I look back — only monuments.

speaker: walker
zh: 火不重。重的是油。
en: The flame weighs nothing. The oil is the weight.

speaker: walker
zh: 到下一塊石再歇。到了,又說下一塊。
en: Rest at the next stone. At the stone: the next one, then.

speaker: walker
zh: 石只數走過的,不數剩下的。
en: The stones count what's walked, never what's left.

speaker: walker
zh: 破曉在東面。一直在東面。
en: Dawn is east. It stays east.

speaker: walker
zh: 路剩多少,無人能說。
en: No one can say how much road is left.

speaker: walker
zh: 有一座碑,手仍舉着,像要接甚麼。
en: One monument still holds its arm out, as if to catch something.

speaker: walker
zh: 灰落在燈罩上,一層,又一層。
en: Ash on the lamp glass. A layer, then a layer.

speaker: walker
zh: 林靠灰養大。灰是誰養大的?
en: The forest feeds on ash. What feeds the ash?

speaker: walker
zh: 第一段,碑最密。起步之地,停步的人最多。
en: The monuments stand thickest here, where the road begins.

speaker: walker
zh: 兩盞燈並亮。火是新的。誰點的?
en: Two lanterns burning side by side. The flames are fresh. Whose?

speaker: walker
zh: 孢子懸在光裏,像未落的灰。
en: Spores hang in the lamplight, like ash that won't come down.

speaker: walker
zh: 樹下有蒼白面具,不止一副。
en: Pale masks under the tree. More than one.

speaker: walker
zh: 根從灰裏伸出來,握着甚麼。
en: Roots reach out of the ash, holding something.

speaker: walker
zh: 灰收走腳步聲。這段路,靜得像沒有人走過。
en: The ash takes the sound of my steps. As if no one had ever walked here.

speaker: walker
zh: 有一座碑靠着樹。樹先到,還是碑先到?
en: A monument leans against a tree. Which of them came first?

speaker: walker
zh: 燒過的林仍在長。長出來的,總會再燒。
en: The burnt forest keeps growing. What grows will burn again.

speaker: walker
zh: 這裏的白,不像任何一種白。
en: The white here is not like any other white.

speaker: walker
zh: 他們向灰祈禱。灰不應人。
en: They pray to the ash. The ash answers no one.

speaker: walker
zh: 燈光照到的,全是灰。照不到的,不去看。
en: Everything in the lamplight is ash. What's past the light, I don't look at.

speaker: walker
zh: 過了樹林,他們說,有一座城。
en: Past the forest, they say, there is a city.

speaker: walker
zh: 水過了城的第二層。城沒有走。
en: The water has taken the city's second storey. The city has not moved.

speaker: walker
zh: 這座城留下來等。水,也留下來。
en: The city stayed to wait. So did the water.

speaker: walker
zh: 水下有光。那光不引路,只引人。
en: There's a light under the water. It leads to nothing — it only leads people.

speaker: walker
zh: 鐵欄蝕剩一半。原來等待,咬得動鐵。
en: The iron rail is eaten half through. So waiting has teeth after all.

speaker: walker
zh: 書庫沉在水裏。他們寫下的,如今水在讀。
en: The library is under the water. What they wrote, the water is reading now.

speaker: walker
zh: 水裏有人走動。不上來,也不沉下去。
en: Someone is moving in the water. Not rising. Not sinking.

speaker: walker
zh: 水下有一口鐘,不響。它還在等甚麼?
en: A bell under the water, silent. What is it still waiting for?

speaker: walker
zh: 城門沒有關。他們不是出不去。
en: The gates were never shut. It isn't that they couldn't leave.

speaker: walker
zh: 這裏的水不流。等着的東西,都不流。
en: The water here doesn't flow. Nothing that waits does.

speaker: walker
zh: 窗內有人影,仍立在原地。
en: Figures at the windows, still standing where they stood.

speaker: walker
zh: 他們信門開那日,人人有份。
en: They believed that when the door opened, it would open for everyone.

speaker: walker
zh: 城選了等。水是等的樣子。
en: The city chose to wait. The water is what waiting looks like.

speaker: walker
zh: 城中無一人向東行,無一人向西返。
en: No one in this city walks east. No one walks back west.

speaker: walker
zh: 潮聲像在數甚麼。
en: The tide sounds like counting.

speaker: walker
zh: 黑曜不透光。燈照上去,只照見自己。
en: Obsidian lets no light through. Raise the lamp to it, and you see only yourself.

speaker: walker
zh: 斷了的光環落在地上,無人拾起。
en: Broken halos on the ground. No one gathers them.

speaker: walker
zh: 越近門,人越多。全部坐着。
en: The nearer the door, the more of them. All seated.

speaker: walker
zh: 這裏的星低,低得像在看。
en: The stars hang low here. Low enough to watch.

speaker: walker
zh: 他們讓路,像讓過許多次。
en: They make way for me, as if they had done it many times before.

speaker: walker
zh: 庭中無火。他們坐在星光裏,坐了太久。
en: No fire in the court. They sit in starlight, and have sat too long.

speaker: walker
zh: 王座之後,他們說,再沒有路。
en: Beyond the throne, they say, the road ends.

speaker: walker
zh: 石上刻着一列數目。最後一筆是新的。
en: A column of tally marks cut into the stone. The last one is fresh.

speaker: walker
zh: 坐着的人望着我,像在等我坐下。
en: The seated ones watch me, as if waiting for me to sit.

speaker: walker
zh: 黑曜裏面,有光死在途中。
en: Inside the obsidian, light has died on its way through.

speaker: walker
zh: 王冠之後的事,他們不說。
en: Of what lies beyond the crown, they do not speak.

speaker: walker
zh: 這段路無灰無水,只有黑曜與靜。
en: No ash on this stretch, no water. Only obsidian, and the quiet.

speaker: walker
zh: 燈的光,在這裏走不遠。
en: Lamplight doesn't travel far here.

speaker: walker
zh: 離門越近,越少人提起它。
en: The closer the door, the less anyone speaks of it.

speaker: walker
zh: 燈還亮。人先熄。
en: The lamp is still burning. I go out first.

speaker: walker
zh: 腳不肯躺。由它站。
en: My legs won't lie down. Let them stand, then.

speaker: walker
zh: 東面有一點亮了。全亮,看不到了。
en: There's a little light in the east. I won't see it full.

speaker: walker
zh: 油交給風,路交給後來的人。
en: The oil goes to the wind. The road goes to whoever comes after.

speaker: walker
zh: 把燈放好。火不該隨我熄。
en: Set the lamp down safe. The flame shouldn't go out with me.

speaker: walker
zh: 冷從腳上來。數到七,不數了。
en: The cold rises from my feet. I counted to seven, then stopped.

speaker: walker
zh: 就到這裏?就到這裏。
en: This far, then? This far.

speaker: walker
zh: 不必記我。路會記。
en: Don't remember me. The road will.

speaker: walker
zh: 我未到。有人會到。
en: Not me. But someone will get there.

speaker: walker
zh: 門等得起。我等不起了。
en: The door can afford to wait. I no longer can.

speaker: walker
zh: 握不住燈了。誰在接?
en: I can't hold the lamp any longer. Who is taking it?

speaker: walker
zh: 風向西。替我帶一句到爐前。
en: The wind runs west. Carry a word to the hearth for me.

speaker: walker
zh: 不必立碑。醒來再走就是。
en: Skip the monument. I'll wake and walk it again.

speaker: walker
zh: 爐前見。
en: See you by the fire.

speaker: walker
zh: 這次不算。
en: This one doesn't count.

speaker: walker
zh: 面向東。記得面向東。
en: Face east. Remember to face east.

speaker: walker
zh: 門開那日,替我多行一步。
en: When the door opens, walk one step of it for me.

speaker: walker
zh: 燈裏還有油。用不完了。
en: There's oil left in the lamp. More than I'll be needing.

speaker: walker
zh: 行到第幾塊石?石記得,我不記得了。
en: Which stone was I on? The stone remembers. I don't.

speaker: walker
zh: 路未完。我完了。
en: The road isn't finished. I am.

speaker: walker
zh: 灰在燈上又一層。這次不抹了。
en: Ash on the lamp again. This time I won't wipe it.

speaker: walker
zh: 未出樹林。第一段都未過。
en: Still in the forest. Not even past the first stretch.

speaker: walker
zh: 兩盞燈仍並亮。我這盞,誰來添油?
en: The paired lamps still burn. Who will oil mine?

speaker: walker
zh: 根在灰下握着的,原來是這個。
en: So this is what the roots were holding.

speaker: walker
zh: 樹在長。我停了,它還在長。
en: The trees keep growing. I stop; they don't.

speaker: walker
zh: 面具白。灰白。我的手,也開始白。
en: The masks are white. The ash is white. My hands are turning white now.

speaker: walker
zh: 靜。只剩燈芯的聲。
en: Quiet. Only the wick still speaking.

speaker: walker
zh: 出發時天未亮。原來一直都未亮。
en: It wasn't light when I set out. It never grew light.

speaker: walker
zh: 還以為第一段容易。
en: I thought the first stretch would be the easy one.

speaker: walker
zh: 樹林之後,他們說有一座城。我看不到了。
en: Past the forest, they say, there's a city. Not for me.

speaker: walker
zh: 水到喉頭。就站在這裏,等它再上。
en: Water at my throat. I'll stand here and let it rise.

speaker: walker
zh: 城等了那麼久。多我一個。
en: The city has waited so long. One more, then.

speaker: walker
zh: 水下那口鐘,響過沒有?
en: That bell under the water — did it ever ring?

speaker: walker
zh: 水下那點光,不是燈。
en: That light down in the water is not a lamp.

speaker: walker
zh: 水中的人仍在走。原來,等是走不完的。
en: The drowned are still walking. Waiting, it turns out, is a road without an end.

speaker: walker
zh: 鐵有蝕,城有水。人有甚麼?
en: Iron has rust. The city has water. What do we have?

speaker: walker
zh: 燈在水上仍亮着,亮得比我久。
en: The lamp still burns above the water. Longer than I will.

speaker: walker
zh: 他們把等待寫了下來。我們的,誰來寫?
en: They wrote their waiting down. Who will write ours?

speaker: walker
zh: 潮退了,又漲。第幾次了?
en: The tide falls and rises. Which time is this?

speaker: walker
zh: 這座城不出聲。今夜多一個不出聲的。
en: The city makes no sound. Tonight there is one more who doesn't.

speaker: walker
zh: 門就在前面。我聞到它的冷。
en: The door is just ahead. I can smell its cold.

speaker: walker
zh: 不坐。他們坐,我不坐。
en: I will not sit. Let them sit. Not me.

speaker: walker
zh: 有光環斷了,不知是誰的。
en: A halo broke somewhere. I don't know whose.

speaker: walker
zh: 星在看。看便看。
en: The stars are watching. Let them watch.

speaker: walker
zh: 王冠之後有甚麼,我到不了了。
en: Whatever lies beyond the crown, I will not reach it.

speaker: walker
zh: 黑曜裏有個我。它不動了。
en: There I am in the obsidian. That one has already stopped moving.

speaker: walker
zh: 坐着的人望過來。我明白那個眼神了。
en: The seated ones are looking at me. I understand that look now.

speaker: walker
zh: 庭中無火。我的熄了,便真的無火了。
en: No fire in this court. When mine goes, there will be none at all.

speaker: walker
zh: 就在門前。原來門前也是路。
en: At the very door. So even the doorstep is still road.

speaker: walker
zh: 油盡了。火去了甚麼地方?
en: The oil is spent. Where has the fire gone?

speaker: queue
zh: 窗亮了。隊伍在門前。
en: The panes are lit. The queue stands at the door.
